# LawnStarter

> > LawnStarter is a nationwide lawn care and landscaping service marketplace connecting homeowners with local professionals for mowing, landscaping, leaf removal, and yard maintenance with instant online booking starting from $19.

LawnStarter operates across hundreds of cities in the United States, offering services backed by their Done Right Guarantee and verified through Trustpilot reviews. The platform provides transparent pricing, instant booking, and connects customers with vetted local lawn care professionals for residential outdoor maintenance.
